$comment: Executable PR claims (Reality Control). scripts/detect-contradictions.mjs verifies refs exist on disk.

claims.assertion: A repair regenerates exactly one beat: the original prompt stays base truth, KEEP/CHANGE narrows from the QA finding, only that clip index is replaced, and the job re-enters the EXISTING assembly worker.

Repair spend passes the policy boundary with the repair cap enforced from the job own history (caller cannot undercount), reserves and settles in the generation ledger, and a provider failure fails the reservation while leaving the job untouched.
